critical_code_review_comments: SESSION 124 IS TIGHT AND CORRECT: J1's timeout tightening (240→150 extra_params, 300→180 wait_for) is symmetric across primary + retry paths and reduces worst-case user wait per Gemini call from 10 min to 6 min. Both extra_params (httpx socket) AND wait_for (asyncio cancel) are tightened together — critical because litellm sometimes ignores asyncio cancel if the httpx request is buffering a large base64 body. Correct fix.

J2 EXCELLENT: The retry_in_progress flag is set BEFORE the retry send_message and cleared in BOTH exit paths (TimeoutError + post-receipt). The post-receipt clear happens BEFORE the extract_json attempt — which is correct because the user only cares 'is the network round-trip still running', not 'did the parse succeed'. If both parses fail, the 502 raises AFTER the flag is already cleared, so the UI transitions from 'Prøver igen for bedste kvalitet…' → error state cleanly.

J2 SMART: Deriving report_id from the session_id prefix (`gate-`/`preview-`/`full-`) is elegant — it means call_gemini_with_video does NOT need a new parameter, keeping the retry_chat call surface backward-compatible with the two other Gemini call sites at L2971 and L3103. Those call sites use different session_id conventions and will silently skip the flag write (correct — no report row to update).

J2 DEFENSIVE: All three db.reports.update_one calls are wrapped in try/except with only a logger.warning on failure — so if the report doc has been deleted or DB is briefly unavailable, the retry itself still proceeds. Good.

J3 CORRECT: Using bool(doc.get('retry_in_progress')) ensures None → False (legacy reports never touched by the retry path show retry_in_progress=false, not undefined). Frontend can safely destructure without a fallback.

J4 CLEAN: The hint is gated on `status?.retry_in_progress` (nullish-safe) and rendered inside the existing Step-N-of-5 pill, below the current step label but above the progress bar — the natural place a user's eye is already tracking. text-amber-300 is a warm attention color without triggering the 'red = error' associations. Italic + small size communicates 'transient extra step' rather than 'new state'.

rca of the issue: PROBLEM: pre-Session-124 users saw silent 10-min hangs at Step 4. Session 123 introduced retry-once (great for correctness) but doubled worst-case Gemini wait to 2 × 300 s = 10 min (bad for UX). ROOT CAUSE: (a) timeout budget too generous — 300 s per attempt was chosen when there was ONE attempt; with retry it compounds. (b) no user feedback during the second attempt — pill still says 'Step 4 · Analyzing' for the full 5 extra minutes. FIX: (a) tightened both extra_params (httpx socket cancel) and asyncio.wait_for (task cancel) proportionally: 240→150 and 300→180 = ~40% wait reduction; worst case now 6 min. Symmetry across primary + retry preserved. (b) added retry_in_progress boolean written to MongoDB before the retry send_message and cleared in both exit branches (timeout + completion). Status endpoint reads and surfaces it; frontend polls the same endpoint (already existing behavior) and renders an amber italic hint when true. Users now see 'Prøver igen for bedste kvalitet…' during the retry window instead of a silent hang. Verified end-to-end: 110/110 regression pass, admin GET /api/reports/{id}/status returns retry_in_progress=false (bool) for a not-in-retry report, JSX grep confirms hint wiring.
